sources: cpwshop campsiteDetails pages for all 109 sites in Conifer Ridge, Grouse Mountain, Peak View, Revenuers Ridge and Prospectors Ridge (parkID 50032), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails: every electric site in Conifer Ridge, Grouse Mountain, Peak View and Revenuers Ridge lists 'Electricity Hookup 30'; no site lists a Water or Sewer Hookup, read 2026-10-27

values.note: 96 electric sites: Conifer Ridge 28 (25-50 ft), Grouse Mountain 32 (24-45 ft, mostly pull-through), Peak View 5 (30-45 ft) and Revenuers Ridge 31 incl. 2 ADA (20-60 ft, mostly pull-through; site 053 only 20 ft). 62 pull-throughs in all. Walk-to tent sites in Prospector Ridge (12) and Revenuers Ridge 054; CPW counts 136 campsites park-wide with group, equestrian and backcountry sites.

sites.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails for all sites in the five loops (site type, Maximum Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + camping page ('136 Campsites'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Coin-operated showers and laundry in the Camper Services Building, closed in winter. In winter the comfort station's flush toilets and one outside spigot stay open, other hydrants are off, and the dump station is dry only.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/mueller-state-park/mueller-state-park-camping-lodging ('Coin-operated showers and laundry facilities', 'Flush toilets', 'Dump station'; 'The Camper Services Building (showers and laundry) is closed for the season'; 'The comfort station, with flush toilets, remains open. Vault toilets are open at Outlook Ridge, Peak View Campground and across from site 87. Water is available at the outside spigot at the comfort station. All other hydrants are closed ... The dump station is dry dump only'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: In winter 29 electric sites stay open in Peak View and Revenuers Ridge; Grouse Mountain and Prospector Ridge (and the other loops) close for the season.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/mueller-state-park/mueller-state-park-camping-lodging ('Mueller offers year-round camping'; 'Mueller has 29 electrical sites available within the Peak View Campground and the Revenuers Ridge Campground during the winter'; 'The following campground loops are closed for the season: Grouse Mountain, Prospector Ridge, Turkey Meadows, and Pisgah Point Group Campground'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; reservations cannot be made at the park. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/mueller-state-park/mueller-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Mueller State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance ... Reservations cannot be made at the park'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Electric sites $36 a night in June, Saturday the same (CPW's park page gives $18-$36 for a campsite). Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass ($10-$15) or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl (cpwshop June 15 and Sat June 19, 2027: Conifer Ridge, Grouse Mountain, Peak View, Revenuers Ridge Electric '$36.00') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/mueller-state-park/mueller-state-park-camping-lodging ('Single campsite (max 6 occupants) 1 Night $18 to $36') + park page ('Daily Vehicle Pass: $10-$15'), read 2026-10-27

note: High-country campground at ~9,500 ft west of Divide: four electric loops (Conifer Ridge, Grouse Mountain, Peak View, Revenuers Ridge) and walk-to tent sites in Prospector Ridge. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + every cpwshop site page in the five loops: confirmed 30-amp electric, 60-ft max, year-round, flush toilets/showers/laundry/dump, $36, reservation-only on cpwshop. Changed sites 99 -> 96 (electric sites; tent sites separate). Added no water/sewer at sites, 62 pull-throughs, vault toilets, water, winter detail (29 sites in Peak View and Revenuers Ridge; showers/laundry closed, dry dump), deep link/window/fcfs never/14-night max, vehicle pass and reservation fee in the fee note. Note: dropped '20/30-amp' (every site is 30) and the field restatements.
flags: Pin is 317 m from the centroid of the 97 sites in the four electric loops (38.89648,-105.18137); fine.
Winter: only 29 electric sites (Peak View and Revenuers Ridge) are open now; the Camper Services Building (showers, laundry) is closed for the season and the dump is dry only. Seasonal, not a status.
Equestrian sites 133-134 (phone-only booking) and the Pisgah Point group loop are not separate entries; neither is a general RV campground.
